samples.title: Flexport sample commercial invoice with legend (Foot Accessory Manufacturing Inc to Sock Importing Company, Inc)
samples.contentNotes: FILLED example, 1 page, digital text layer. Supplier Foot Accessory Manufacturing Inc (Shenzhen, China), importer of record Sock Importing Company, Inc (Los Angeles). Invoice No. FP123456 dated 5/16/16. 3 line items with PO#, SKU, description, material content, quantity (pieces), unit value USD, total: 1111123/AB1234 women's ankle socks 250 x $2.00 = $500.00; 1111124/BC2345 clothes hangers 300 x $2.15 = $645.00; 1111125/CD3456 yarn 150 x $2.22 = $333.00; total USD $1,478.00; country of origin China. Numbered callouts 1-9 overlaid on the form plus a 'Guide to commercial invoice items' legend at the bottom, so the text extract contains stray digits. No weights, no HS codes, no incoterm. URL 302-redirects to a presigned S3 URL, so fetch the public-endpoints URL with redirects followed (curl -L) and do not pin the S3 URL. pdfinfo logs a recoverable 'xref num 3 not found' warning.
samples.license: unstated for the file; site Terms of Use (https://www.flexport.com/terms-and-conditions/terms-of-use/) prohibit copying/redistributing content without a separate license

samples.title: GLS Belgium example invoice + summary + statement on origin (EU to UK export)
samples.contentNotes: FILLED example with placeholder parties ('Name Shipper/Exporter', 'Name Importer'), 3 pages, Word-generated digital text. Page 1: Invoice N°12345 dated 01/01/2020, order 'Your N° 999999', ship date 05/01/2020, delivery to United Kingdom; 3 lines with item ref, 8-digit HS code, description, origin, quantity, net kg, gross kg, unit price, total, currency: 42021299 synthetic trunk CN 2 / 2.000 / 2.500 / 10.00 / 20.00 GBP; 42029291 backpack PK 1 / 0.500 / 0.800 / 6.00; 42029291 backpack CN 1 / 0.400 / 0.800 / 5.00; totals 4 pcs, net 2.900 kg, gross 4.100 kg, 31.00 GBP + freight 10.00 + insurance 2.00 = 43.00 GBP; incoterm DAP; 1 carton; footnotes 1-8. Page 2: multi-invoice summary table, which swaps the net and gross columns for N°12345 (net 4.100, gross 2.900) and prints '43 .00', a real internal inconsistency useful as a reconciliation test case. Page 3: blank EU-UK TCA statement on origin text. 'LOGO' placeholder image. Carries a GLS non-binding/no-liability disclaimer. Also served byte-identical at https://assistantapi.gls-group.eu/BE/media/downloads/Example_Invoice__Statement_on_Origin~1.pdf.
